body.brief: Original fictional logo-free year2994 sage-green salvage compact SUV inspired only by 2024 Forester proportions. Transparent 4x2 eight-angle sheet; cream roof, amber lamps, black cladding, pixel-art detail. No wheels: transparent openings for runtime tire sprites. No logos, text, ground, shadows or scenery.
body.note: Angles assigned by inspecting generated orientation, not trusting prompt angle labels. Original pixels retained.

dashboard.brief: Original fictional left-hand-drive sage-green and charcoal salvage SUV dashboard, transparent windshield area, large empty left instrument binnacle. No steering wheel, numbers, gauges, needles, text, logos or scenery; shared wheel and dynamic instruments added by game. Crisp pixel-art detail.
